title: hieracium alatum subsp. subolivaceum
intro: Hieracium alatum subsp. subolivaceum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae) and native to Europe. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as wounds, skin issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium alatum subsp. subolivaceum include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
